description: This file is a PHP source file that generates a web page for configuring Wi-Fi settings in a router or gateway device, including network names, security modes, passwords, and related UI interactions.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the Wi-Fi configuration data to the server via AJAX for saving.

methods.name: addslashes
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for safe inclusion in JSON.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration object, and calls set_config to save Wi-Fi settings.
